description: This source file implements a sample server-client application using the WPEFramework core library. It includes a privileged request server that manages shared files, handles command-line options, and provides a simple interactive interface for requesting file descriptors and writing to shared files.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A server class inheriting from Core::PrivilegedRequest that manages shared files, handles service requests, and logs file operations.

methods.name: ParseOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine if the server mode is enabled and to extract the identifier.

methods.name: Server::Server
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shared files, creates them, and writes initial log entries.

methods.name: Server::~Server
methods.description: Destructor that logs closure and cleans up shared files.

methods.name: Server::Service
methods.description: Provides file descriptors for shared files to clients based on the request.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up server or client mode, handles user interaction, and manages request flow.
